resources.string: Try features that are still being validated. All experiments are off by default.
Experimental features may continue to change. Each feature has its own switch and does not participate in processing while disabled.

When you edit a transcript, the changed word pair and up to 240 nearby characters will be sent to the configured language model to decide whether the correction is worth learning.\n\nWhen a learned entry matches later, only nearby text is sent. Audio, titles, summaries, and complete recordings are never sent. Every automatic replacement can be disabled or deleted.
Unavailable: configure an API key for the current language model first.
Enabled: learns from transcript edits. Custom dictionary entries take priority when they conflict.
Disabled: does not collect edits, call the correction model, or apply learned entries.
Enabled: Always replace entries work now; Context-aware entries activate after an API key is configured.
Enabled: saved entries are applied to future transcripts using their selected mode.
Disabled: entries are neither loaded nor applied, but saved entries are retained.
Opt in to features that are still being validated
